oil.when: 2005–2007 (Change Engine Oil / Change Oil Soon light)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the key to RUN (ON) but do not start the engine.
Push the accelerator pedal all the way down and let it up three times within five seconds.
The change oil light should flash to show the system has reset.
Turn the key off. If the light comes back on and stays on at the next key-on, repeat the steps.
Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the key to ON/RUN with the engine off.
Push the accelerator pedal all the way down and let it up three times within five seconds.
If the change engine oil light is off, the system has reset.
If the light comes back on and stays on for about 30 seconds at the next key-on, repeat the steps.
oil.note: On a 2010 with a Driver Information Center, you can also show OIL LIFE REMAINING with the vehicle information button and hold the set/reset button for about 5 seconds until it reads 100%.

steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the tire label on the driver's door pillar.
There is no reset button. The low tire pressure light goes off once the tires are at the correct pressure.
If the light still comes on at each start, recheck every tire with a gauge, including for a slow leak.
tpms.note: If the light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault that adding air will not fix. After a tire rotation or a sensor change, the sensors must be matched to their positions with a TPMS tool or the key fob procedure in the owner's manual.
